segments.he: אַחַר כָּךְ אָכַלְתִּי סְעֻדַּת הַצָּהֳרַיִם בְּבֵית אַכְסַנְיָא שֶׁלִּי בְּבֵית רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם אַחַר כָּךְ הָלַכְתִּי לְהַעֲבִיר כָּל הַחֲפָצִים שֶׁלִּי מִבֵּית רַבִּי נַפְתָּלִי לְבֵית רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם כִּי עֲדַיִן הָיוּ כָּל הַחֲפָצִים שֶׁלִּי מֻנָּחִים בְּבֵית רַבִּי נַפְתָּלִי מִלֵּיל ג' עַד עַתָּה וְשָׂכַרְתִּי עֲגָלָה וְהֶעֱבַרְתִּי אוֹתָם לְבֵית רַבִּי אַבְרָהָם לָאַכְסַנְיָא שֶׁלִּי אַחַר כָּךְ הָלַכְנוּ לְבֵית רַבִּי משֶׁה שֶׁשָּׁם הִתְפַּלַּלְנוּ בְּראשׁ הַשָּׁנָה הֶעָבָר:
segments.en: On Sunday — the day after Yom Kippur — called Shem Hashem — the year 5585 — Hashem Blessed be He helped me: an answer reached me from Vilna — to send there a small sum and they would immediately send me a license. And immediately I gave thanks to Hashem Blessed be He. And I was aroused to collect the money. And I immediately sent on the first post — on Tuesday of that week — the sum they had written to me. And now we are hoping at every time for Hashem's salvation — that the license will arrive — and the printing house will be opened. And the crown will be restored to its former place — to print the books of Rabbainu zichrono livracha — to illuminate the face of the world — to reveal his truth in the world. Amen — so may it be the will.
